intro_text: 100% of your contributions go directly toward patient medications, health screening supplies, and educational scholarships.

paynow.title: Donate via PayNow
paynow.instructions: Scan the PayNow QR code or enter UEN/Entity name. Please include 'Project Battambang' in the reference field.

cheque.title: Donate via Cheque
cheque.instructions: Cross cheques payable to 'National University of Singapore'. On the reverse, write 'Project Battambang' along with your contact details.
